values_native_or_proxy: native stock OHLCV; beta_proxy is derived from panel p20 vs market-median p20

v23_design.return_model: cross-sectional ridge regression (re-fitted walk-forward each month)
v23_design.neutralization: daily residualization by industry dummies + beta_proxy

limitations: beta is proxy-derived from p20 co-movement, not native return beta
linear ridge may miss nonlinear effects
